_comment: Tuning for tools/deid.py. 'exclude' takes globs relative to the project root, or absolute forward-slash paths; matching files are neither scanned nor blocked. Use it only for confirmed false positives (library versions, article ids, accession numbers), never to silence a real identifier.
_comment_memory: Claude's own memory directory is excluded: it must never hold patient data, it is loaded into context every session regardless of this guard, and its project notes carry counts that trip the date rules.
_comment_vendor: Minified vendor CSS/JS carries long digit runs that the bare 7-8 digit chart sweep reads as chart numbers. These are library assets saved alongside a page, never clinical text.
_comment_raw_dirs: Raw HIS captures live outside the project and outside OneDrive. Each entry maps a raw directory to the folder under deid/ where its de-identified twins are written.
